title: Surveillance of Treatment of Children With Growth Hormone Deficiency With Zomacton®
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the long-term treatment with Zomacton® for pituitary short stature in children with insufficient growth hormone production and/or short stature caused by Turner's syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* therapeutic need according to the approved specific products characteristics (SPC)

Exclusion Criteria:

* contraindication according to the SPC
study_population: Children with inadequate secretion of growth-hormone; growth retardation due to Turner's syndrome
